title: console(dashboard): a dataset widget's compareTo previousPeriod is labelled "vs yesterday" — the label is guessed from {today} in the raw filter while the executor compares the whole preceding window
body:
QA-source: objectstack-ai/objectstack#21782 · dashboards.chart-type-matrix · outside the item's clauses

A defect found while running `dashboards.chart-type-matrix` (outside the item's clauses) surfaced in the ObjectStack 17.7 pre-release checklist run objectstack-ai/objectstack#21782 (framework subject `316be321e`, console pin `2e818d0b51ec`). An independent verifier (VF3, RUNNER rule 7; code only) confirmed it: P3 (label only; the comparison values are right). It predates the 17.6.0 console pin `31971ff1e`; no open duplicate was found. Owner: objectui.

## Reproduction

1. As admin, `PUT /api/v1/meta/dashboard/qa_compareto_probe?mode=draft` with:
   - `dateRange:{field:'created_at', defaultRange:'last_30_days'}`;
   - a metric widget on dataset `showcase_task_metrics`, `values:['task_count']`, `compareTo:{kind:'previousPeriod'}`.
2. `POST /api/v1/meta/dashboard/qa_compareto_probe/publish`.
3. Server truth: the dataset query's `timeDimensions` dateRange is `[2026-09-04, 2026-10-04]`, and `task_count__compare` is 1, so the previous 30 days.
4. Browser: `/_console/apps/showcase_app/dashboard/qa_compareto_probe`.
5. Expected: "vs previous period".
6. Actual: the metric reads "9 ↑800%" "vs yesterday", and the line legend reads "Tasks · vs yesterday".

## Mechanism

- `packages/core/src/utils/compare-to.ts:124-136` `compareToTrendLabelKey` regex-sniffs the raw filter for macro tokens (`\btoday\b` → `vsYesterday`).
- `plugin-dashboard/src/DatasetWidget.tsx:1097` reuses it on the ADR-0021 dataset path, where the framework executor shifts the dimension window to the equal-length window before it (`packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-executor.ts:810-819` `shiftRange`).
- The heuristic is faithful only on the inline path (`compare-to.ts` ~100-118). The same code is at `31971ff1e` (`DatasetWidget.tsx:995`).

## Done when

On the dataset path the label comes from the compareTo kind and the resolved window, not from filter-token sniffing (pinned).
